- TOTAL revenue was £44.3k in TW against £59.7k in LW, a WoW change of -25.9%.

- DOORMAT KEEP CALM AND COME IN fell £4,037.00 WoW and JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT fell £3,120.41 WoW; JUMBO BAG PINK POLKADOT was -71.9% WoW while HOT WATER BOTTLE TEA AND SYMPATHY was -2.9% WoW.
